verdict.rationale: Jev is an API service, so issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions API key management, permission scopes or restricted credentials. It covers only SDK usage, rate limits, model listing per account and a Playground login, none of which shows scoped credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
